en: A sepia-toned historic street scene showing a large ornate late‑19th‑century bank or savings building on a city square, with horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians, trees, and a sculpted column or monument in the foreground. The façade of the main building bears Hungarian inscriptions, and printed captions at the bottom identify the location and the institution. The reverse side is a blank divided-back postcard with Hungarian text for 'postcard' and the publisher's line along the left edge.
